entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: For Respondent(s) : Mr. Sameer Pareek, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUDESH BANSAL Order 06/12/2025 1.

Instant bail application has been filed by petitioner under Section 483 of BNSS in connection with FIR No. 324/2025 registered at Police Station- Savina, District- Udaipur for offence under Section 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC.

2. Heard counsel for petitioner as well as learned Public Prosecutor and perused the material available on record.
3.

Having considered the fact that the petitioner is neither seller nor purchaser and not beneficiary of the alleged fraud sale, petitioner has been implicated on the ground that he is a typist, typed the forged document, petitioner is in custody since 27.102025, offences are triable by Judicial Magistrate, previous three criminal antecedents of the petitioner are more than 12 years old and conclusion of trial will take considerable time, but
[2025:RJ-JD:52972] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-14412/2025] without commenting on merits of the case, this Court deems it just and proper to release the petitioner on bail.

Anil vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:52972) on 6 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176850734/
1 4.

Accordingly, the bail application is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner Anil S/o Ganesh Lal shall be released on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.

5. However, considering the pendency of criminal cases of the petitioner, it is hereby directed that the petitioner shall not repeat the similar nature of offence and shall cooperate with the investigation, during bail granted by this Court, and in case, breach of any of the condition is reported or comes to the notice of the Court, same shall be the reason for the trial Court to cancel the bail, granted by this Court.
(SUDESH BANSAL),J 103-Jatin/-
